summary: Visual-only landing/welcome swap verified end-to-end at 390x844. BACKEND smoke: GET /api/ = 200 ({app:'Level Up Trading Hub'}), POST /api/auth/login demo creds = 200 with access_token + user. FRONTEND (Expo web preview): logged-out route renders welcome-screen with the supplied landing artwork (assets/images/landing-hero.jpg), Create account (primary gradient), Log in (outline), 'OR CONTINUE WITH' divider, Apple/Google/Email provider row, and footer taglines 'CONNECT | GROW | BELONG' + 'ANY MARKET. ANY STYLE. EVERY JOURNEY.'; no layout overflow at 844 (google button bottom Y=769, page scroll not needed). Routing: welcome-signup-button → /signup, welcome-login-button → /login, welcome-email-button → /signup, welcome-apple-button shows 'Apple sign-in is coming soon' toast, welcome-google-button visible (not clicked per instructions). Back button returns to welcome each time. Regression: demo login → home-screen with stories-row (You/Sophia/Marcus/Ava/Devon/Discover) + post cards (post-video, post-media-0 mentions incl. mention-marcus_fx) loads correctly; tab-profile → profile-screen; profile-menu-button opens sheet → 'Log out' redirects to /welcome and welcome-screen is visible. No red screens; only one benign RN-web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (framework-level, not from welcome.tsx).
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx: clean, only styling + navigation; uses Pressable + testIDs on every interactive element (welcome-signup/login/apple/google/email-button) and a stable welcome-screen root — matches Testing spec.
Uses insets.top on heroWrap and insets.bottom+16 on actions — safe-area handled without SafeAreaView deprecation risk.
Uses expo-image and expo-linear-gradient (both current, non-deprecated) — no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage introduced.
loginWithGoogle wired via useAuth (existing flow) and googleBusy disables tap + swaps to ActivityIndicator — good state handling.
